summary.tldr: Requires airlines to count flight attendants’ pre- and post-flight duties, mandatory training, and some delay time as paid work at regular wages.
what_it_does: Requires employers to count time flight attendants spend on pre-flight and post-flight duties, including security checks, passenger service, and helping people board and leave the aircraft, when calculating paid hours.
Requires employers to count time flight attendants spend completing mandatory training programs when calculating paid hours.
Requires employers to count time flight attendants are at work, at the employer’s call and disposal, including during flight delays, whether or not the delay is within the employer’s control.
Requires employers to pay flight attendants at least their regular wage rate for this work.
summary.background: It adds a new Division I.01 for flight attendants to the Canada Labour Code.
